item.title: Pattonville pays tribute to student murdered with father
item.description: In a gymnasium normally filled with green, purple was displayed at Pattonville High School on Tuesday in the form of balloons, T-shirts, sweatshirts, and other tributes. The 15-year-old student athlete was murdered on Saturday along with her father, Henry Williams, a former chief of the Berkeley Fire Department.
